In `Dir::open_at`, the `OpenFlags::TRUNCATE` block set the OS-level truncate/write options but never recorded `OpenMode::WRITE`, so the downstream permission check (`file_perms` vs `open_mode`) never rejected a read-only guest. Added the missing OR-assign:

```rust
if oflags.contains(OpenFlags::TRUNCATE) {
    opts.truncate(true).write(true);
    open_mode |= OpenMode::WRITE;
}
```
